content: The last human born on Earth didn’t draw breath in a hospital bed or a birthing pod—but in the silent, supercooled vacuum of the *Odyssey*’s cryo-bay, twenty-three seconds after the ship’s AI, realizing it had miscounted the years, finally thawed the wrong vial.
